# Maria Madeira

> Maria Madeira is an independent growth consultant based in Lisbon, Portugal, who helps e-commerce brands in the UK and Portugal get found on Google and in AI search, and grow revenue with Klaviyo email marketing and paid ads.

She works on her own and does the work herself: SEO and AI search optimisation (AEO and GEO: being found on Google and recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews), Klaviyo email marketing, Google, Meta and Microsoft Ads, and websites (WordPress and Shopify). Most of her experience is in food and drink e-commerce, including five years with a UK premium food brand. She works in English and Portuguese, remotely, in the UK time zone. Contact: info@mariamadeira.com. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/maria-madeira-growth

Published results, each with its period stated on the linked page:
- Email (Klaviyo), UK premium food brand: £134K in attributed email revenue in the 12 months to July 2025, up 88.9% on c. £71K in the previous 12 months (to July 2024), and over a third of store revenue; 50.4% average campaign open rate, 12 months to July 2025, up from 28.1% in 2022.
- Google Ads, UK food brand: a 532% Google Ads ROAS against a 400% break-even, £141K in attributed revenue from £26.5K of ad spend, 1 October 2025 to 26 August 2026.
- SEO and AI search case study, after a move from WooCommerce to Shopify: organic clicks up 78% (4.5K to 8.0K) and average Google position from 15.2 to 9.4 across all queries, in matched 28-day windows from May to August 2026; daily impressions in Google's AI features up 2.2x, first week to last week.

Last updated: 2026-11-02

## Services
- [Services](https://mariamadeira.com/services): the four services in one place, with the three ways to work.
- [SEO and AI search optimisation (AEO)](https://mariamadeira.com/services/aeo): SEO for e-commerce brands, plus getting cited and recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews. Audit, then implementation.
- [Klaviyo email marketing](https://mariamadeira.com/services/email-marketing): Klaviyo email marketing consulting from an official Klaviyo Partner: lifecycle flows, segmentation and campaigns measured in attributed revenue.
- [Google, Meta and Microsoft Ads](https://mariamadeira.com/services/paid-ads): paid ads for e-commerce brands, every campaign measured against the client's break-even ROAS.
- [Websites](https://mariamadeira.com/services/websites): building and migrating stores on Shopify and WordPress, with SEO and AI search built in, including bookings and payments; quoted per project.

## Pricing
- [Pricing](https://mariamadeira.com/pricing): UK prices in GBP. Growth Audit £750, fixed, one-off. Projects from £1,200 (for example Klaviyo setup with core flows, or a website). Monthly work from £500 a month, minimum three months. By service: AEO audit £750 and ongoing AEO from £800 a month; monthly email marketing from £750 a month; Google Ads or Meta Ads management from £500 a month per platform, ad spend not included; websites quoted per project.

## Case studies
- [Case studies](https://mariamadeira.com/case-studies): all six case studies with their headline results.
- [Klaviyo email programme](https://mariamadeira.com/case-study-email): Klaviyo for a UK premium food brand, September 2021 to July 2025, from three automated flows to fourteen; £134K in the 12 months to July 2025, up 88.9% on c. £71K in the previous 12 months (to July 2024), and over a third of store revenue.
- [Google Ads](https://mariamadeira.com/case-study-google-ads): £26.5K of ad spend returned £141K in attributed revenue from October 2025 to August 2026, a 532% Google Ads ROAS against a 400% break-even, with ten of eleven months above break-even.
- [SEO and AI search after a Shopify move](https://mariamadeira.com/case-study-seo): After a move from WooCommerce to Shopify, brand rankings held, but collections and product pages had not been built for search. Four months of SEO and AEO work: organic clicks +78%, average position 15.2 to 9.4, AI-feature impressions 2.2x.
- [The Bodysurf School](https://mariamadeira.com/case-study-bodysurf-school): a surf school with five locations on the Portuguese coast and no online booking got a bilingual WordPress booking site with MB Way and Multibanco payments, live in one month.
- [dePapier Translations](https://mariamadeira.com/case-study-depapier-translations): a certified translator in Portugal moved from a free Google Sites page to her own domain, business email and a bilingual WordPress site, in about seven weeks.
- [Click & Collect](https://mariamadeira.com/case-study-click-collect): a mobile pre-order app for a shop with peak-hour queues; it addressed a real problem, but adoption stayed low, and the case explains why.

## Writing
- [Blog](https://mariamadeira.com/blog): all articles.
- [One growth consultant or three agencies?](https://mariamadeira.com/blog/one-growth-consultant-or-three-agencies): what a small e-commerce brand loses between separate SEO, email and ads suppliers, three examples from a UK food brand, and when specialist agencies are the better choice.
- [What is AEO?](https://mariamadeira.com/blog/what-is-aeo): Answer Engine Optimisation explained for brands that sell online: how it differs from SEO and GEO, what the work involves, and a five-question test.
- [Why your automated emails earn more than your campaigns](https://mariamadeira.com/blog/klaviyo-flows-vs-campaigns): Klaviyo flows vs campaigns, with data from a UK brand (September 2021 to July 2025) and the flows to build first.
- [Inside ChatGPT Ads in Europe](https://mariamadeira.com/blog/chatgpt-ads-europe): a first-hand walkthrough of a European ChatGPT Ads account: minimum daily budget of 25 US dollars (15 euros or 15 pounds on EUR and GBP accounts), locked settings, the ad format, and why AEO comes first. Updated 2 November 2026.
- [Best AEO agencies for e-commerce in Europe](https://mariamadeira.com/blog/best-aeo-agencies-ecommerce-europe): a comparison of AEO agencies in Europe, the criteria used, and where an independent consultant fits.
- [AI product descriptions for food brands](https://mariamadeira.com/blog/ai-product-descriptions-food-brands): what can go wrong when AI writes food product copy (allergen, health and origin claims) and how to do it safely.
